text:
Nora L.: hey 👋 first day questions: where do i post small things vs big asks? e.g., "network guest wifi", "expense receipt", "time off", "PR review ping", and random lunch? also curious about muting bots but still getting important pings.

Priya (People Ops): welcome Nora! short map: 
- Guest wifi / building access -> #help (IT) or DM Facilities for same-day stuff.
- Expense receipts -> #finance with the expense form link (please attach receipts).
- Time off -> use the PTO Slack app / request in #people-ops (only managers see requests).
- Lunch/social -> #random or #lunch-plans.

Priya (People Ops): Tip: use the PTO app instead of channel for official approvals so they're tracked.

Diego Infra: For infra things: 
- Node/GPU failures, training jobs -> #eng-infra
- Deploy flakiness / rollouts -> #eng-releases (don't post deploy logs in #eng).
- Small config Qs or quick help -> threads in #eng-platform so the channel stays scannable.

Riley Eng: PR review etiquette: ping reviewers in the PR or add a quick comment in #eng-code-reviews with a link, but avoid pasting diffs into Slack. If you need an emergency review, add :zap: and @reviewer-ops.

Nora L.: how to mute bots? i don't want to see daily standups but still want mentions.

Diego Infra: mute channel or set notification prefs: "Notification preferences > Mentions & reactions" then turn off "All new messages" but keep "Direct messages, mentions & keywords". For bots that spam, you can request channel admins to move noisy automations into a dedicated channel (e.g., #ci-notifications).

releases-bot: Deployment started: service=renderer commit=8f3d9f  (posted to #eng-releases)

Riley Eng: wanted to add: reactions are our quick ACKs — use :eyes: for "i saw this" and :white_check_mark: when done. Saves a bunch of small messages.

Nora L.: good to know. and guest wifi creds — who do i ping if a vendor arrives?

Priya (People Ops): ping Facilities or post in #people-ops with vendor name and time; Facilities will message you. For same-day pickups call the office line (info on the handbook).

standup-bot: Today's standup: 1) Blocker: none 2) Today: onboarding setup 3) Help needed: access requests

Nora L.: last q — exceptions to @channel/@here?

Diego Infra: only for urgent, org-wide signals (e.g., major outage). For schedule reminders or team notices use scheduled messages or the calendar app. Overuse reduces signal.

Riley Eng: pro tip: create a small private channel for your immediate team if you want fewer cross-team pings; invite only the people you need.

Nora L.: thanks all! this is really clear. joining #new-hires now and i'll fill the access forms. :raised_hands:
